purpose: Copy tables from the analytics read replica into a staging bucket every night so the vendor can load them into their warehouse.

components.name: sync-job
components.evidence: the thing that does the copy is the sync-job (a.k.a. "the feeder" in the old doc)

components.name: analytics_replica
components.evidence: reads from the analytics read replica (PostgreSQL)

components.name: staging_bucket
components.evidence: writes extract files to the staging bucket (S3)

components.name: sync_audit
components.evidence: the service pulls its credentials from the approved secret store

flows.evidence: the sync-job copies the selected tables from the analytics read replica into one extract file per table
writes extract files to the staging bucket (S3)
the vendor picks up the files from there
